payment-notice.v3.revision_rule: Original event, buyer, order and durable availability time must match the retained intent.
payment-notice.v3.duplicate_rule: Identical receipt is idempotent; conflicting receipt is denied.
payment-notice.v3.uncertain_rule: Keep notification pending and retry the same receipt.

event_input.subject: order_id
event_input.status: Canonical scoped receiver for required payment notices. The alternate inbox receipt path remains deferred.

recovery.missing_operator: Keep failed deliveries held with an unassigned recovery record and continue retrying.
recovery.ownership: Create a recovery record on failed delivery or when the signing key is missing. Assign the configured operator when available and preserve the assignment on retry.
recovery.escalation_due: Durable notice availability plus 48 hours without acknowledgement.
recovery.escalation: Record escalation and bilingual next action durably; resolve only after receipt acknowledgement.
recovery.migration: Allow a held recovery record to remain unassigned until an operator is configured.
recovery.connected_proof: Configured operator identity and operational response remain deferred.
